versions.changelog:
Initial release of the realtor-com-property-data skill.

- Provides structured JSON access to Realtor.com listings, property details, market stats, agents, and locations through 6 endpoints.
- Supports for sale, pending, rent, sold, and agent filtering with up to 200 listings per call.
- Delivers comprehensive data, including price/tax history, home value estimates, school info, flood/fire risk, and agent profiles with reviews.
- Requires free SCAVIO_API_KEY for use; all endpoints cost 1 credit per call.
- Includes detailed setup instructions and parameter documentation.
